prompt: Use the supplied first and last images for the same subject and framing. Starting at the screen-right pose, make one continuous sweep through lower-right, down and lower-left to the screen-left final pose. Both eyes follow the same direction as the face. Keep the demonstrated subject-appropriate range, original expression, stable torso and camera. Do not take the upper route, reverse direction, or return to neutral.

motionPlan.assembly: First lower arc; review before preparing the remaining upper arc and joining both endpoints
motionPlan.durationReason: 首段小样，后续段另按已有预算规划

identity.expected: 保留原始身份、表情、嘴部状态与配饰
identity.verify: 与原始身份基准对照全片，不能只比较首尾

motion.expected: 右经下方到左的单段，不能声称完整方向环
motion.verify: 逐段核对实际转脸与抬低头，不能用侧倾替代缺失方向

range.expected: 按实际主体和用途确定幅度，不能只由极端接缝图决定
range.verify: 输入检查记录具体幅度意图，成片核对全部极值

gaze.expected: 可见眼睛与脸协同追踪目标，遮挡处记未知
gaze.verify: 放大检查上下左右及中间段；未知不写通过

fixedParts.expected: 固定身体与构图，页面背景沿用原场景
fixedParts.verify: 对照身体锚点与真实场景合成，检查颈部接缝

loop.expected: 本段不闭环；拼装后核对每个接点
loop.verify: 比较首尾两侧多帧姿态、运动方向与停顿

rest.expected: 当前采用原静态回退；未实现自然回正
rest.verify: 交付时说明切换限制，由用户验收实际体验
